answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before transacting, like a walnut shell guarding its kernel, released only after peers attest honest behavior. Identity also needs a pigment fingerprint, a unique hash of the agent code and hardware key, so clones share one fingerprint and are rejected. A crystal-clear public ledger records stakes and fingerprints, so spawning thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes and forging distinct proofs, making sybil attacks cost far more than any gain from faked volume.
